scene: The dryer pops open, revealing a hidden tunnel to transit lines.
picture: A flat side view inside the back room tunnel. On the left sits an open silver subway train door. Centre sits an idling yellow street tram. Far right, a green harbour ferry gangway rests beside water. The player in yellow raincoat and green boots stands between them, holding a red umbrella.
